title: Budget and Revenue
text:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

Figure 1 plots each film’s budget against its revenue.

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget (million USD)")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (million USD)")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Budget against revenue (million USD)

title: Box Office Numbers
text: This website explores a dataset well-known films released between 1980 and 2025. For each film, it record the franchise, the product budget, and owrldwide revenue in millions of US dollars, the runtime, and the IMDb rating. The figures are rounded and not adjusted for inflation.

title: Runtime and Ratings

import pandas as pd

plt.ylabel("IMDb rating")

title: The Bond Films
text:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")


bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")
plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (million USD)")
plt.show()








The dataset covers Bond films from 1995 to 2021.
